MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB hub fits my history of adding computer connections and accessories; external power and individual switches give me a practical reason to consider it, although ten ports may exceed my needs.",
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone connect to my earlier headset interest, but that makes them relevant to consider rather than something I need to replace now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV devices and smart display introduce entertainment or voice-assistant uses that my computer accessory purchases do not suggest I currently want.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender does not follow from buying an Ethernet adapter: needing a wired connection does not mean I have poor wireless coverage.",
    "The memory card and drive mounting kit require a particular device or installation project, and I have no current need for either.",
    "The wireless earbuds do not address a current audio need, and adding another charging routine gives me less reason to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in streaming devices and smart-home equipment.",
    "Past purchases of networking and desktop accessories seem to have been treated as ongoing needs for any related upgrade."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases mostly help existing equipment connect or work together; that practical purpose matters more to me than simply being another electronic device.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart, so an old headset or desktop accessory purchase is a weak reason to assume I need a replacement or another installation now.",
    "A related accessory becomes useful when I have a specific connection, device, or project in mind; similarity alone rarely makes me act."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You partly understood my interest in practical computer connections, but assumed too many additional device and upgrade needs from it."
}
